name: Adaptive Octree Encoding
definition: A memory layout for storing adaptive octree AMR data where each node is represented by a 64-bit descriptor and children are stored contiguously in an array to reduce memory overhead.
summary: Adaptive Octree Encoding stores Tree-Based AMR data in an adaptive-resolution octree to preserve hierarchy, enabling faster ray traversal and higher quality rendering than flattening to unstructured grids.
